facts.text: Molloy Catholic College was founded by the Dominican Sisters of the Congregation of the Holy Cross Amityville, welcoming an incoming class of 44 young women under first president Mother Anselma Ruth O.P., Ph.D. on September 12, 1955.

sources.title: History and Traditions - Molloy University
sources.quote: Molloy Catholic College was founded by the Dominican Sisters of the Congregation of the Holy Cross Amityville.

sources.title: History and Traditions - Molloy University
sources.quote: With the support of Bishop Thomas E. Molloy and the encouragement of Monsignor Peter Quealy, on September 12, 1955, Mother Anselma Ruth O.P., Ph.D., first president of Molloy College welcomed an incoming class of 44 young women.

facts.text: The founders of Molloy, the Dominican Sisters of Amityville, established the institution with the belief that conferring professional degrees with a strong liberal arts core would allow students to serve in their chosen fields with excellence, compassion, and creativity.

sources.title: About Molloy University
sources.quote: The founders, the Dominican Sisters of Amityville, believed that conferring professional degrees with a strong liberal arts core would allow students to serve in their chosen fields of work with excellence, compassion and creativity.
